notes: backend/package.json: many @aws-sdk/* clients (aws), @google-cloud/kms (google-cloud), @openai/agents and OPENAI_API_KEY (openai), posthog-node and POSTHOG_* (posthog), dd-trace and DATADOG_* (datadog); SENTRY_DSN in the env template (sentry). Integrations that connect to customers' own accounts (INF_APP_CONNECTION_AZURE_*, INF_APP_CONNECTION_STRIPE_*, the mongodb driver for rotating secrets in customer databases) are not Infisical's own processors and are not counted; @azure/identity appears only in an overrides block. Known false positive: mongodb-atlas, recorded in knownFalsePositives.
